name: How long does a typical aging-in-place remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical aging-in-place remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an aging-in-place remodel depends heavily on its complexity and scale. Minor modifications, like installing grab bars or a comfort-height toilet, might take a few hours to a few days. Larger projects, such as a full bathroom conversion or kitchen renovation, can take several weeks to a few months, factoring in design, material procurement, and construction. A clear timeline will be provided after the project scope is defined.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration of an aging-in-place remodel varies from a few hours for minor changes to several weeks or months for larger projects like full bathroom or kitchen renovations.
